|immunethrall = No |id1 = 14105 |id2 = 14106 }} }} '''Baby blue dragons''' are the young of adult [[blue dragon]]s found in [[Taverley Dungeon]], the [[Isle of Souls Dungeon]], the bottom floor of the [[Ruins of Tapoyauik]], and in the basement of the [[Myths' Guild]]. Unlike their adult forms, they do not breathe fire. Players who wish to kill baby blue dragons without being attacked by the adult blue dragons can find some in the Taverley Dungeon near the [[lava eel]] fishing spot, south of the [[Agility]] [[shortcut]]. They can also be killed on the east side of the main Taverley Dungeon room as no adult blue dragon will walk there. They can be killed as an alternative for a blue dragon [[Slayer task]]. ==Locations== {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |name = Baby blue dragon |location = [[Corsair Cove Dungeon]]/[[Myths' Guild|Myths'
